implementation.semantics: Ignore is an account-scoped presentation preference and remains distinct from block: it does not alter message, call, friendship or channel authorization.
implementation.persistence: ignoredUsers is a bounded, server-validated preference map and participates in the existing versioned preference merge, retry and account cache flow.
implementation.entry_point: Member cards expose Ignore and Stop ignoring actions without destructive confirmation or block side effects.
implementation.rendering: Messages from ignored users retain their author and history position but collapse content, previews, attachments and reactions behind an explicit per-message Show action.
implementation.management: Privacy settings list ignored identifiers, support search and remove exactly one ignored entry.
